concept.title: People affected by crime or abuse
concept.shortdesc: Offenders, victims of crime and survivors of domestic, sexual or other abuse.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Offenders, ex-offenders and people in prison or on probation, together with victims of crime and their families.
: Survivors and victims of domestic abuse, sexual violence, stalking or childhood abuse, and those worried about someone else being abused.
